titulo: Live: Russian strike on apartment building in Ukraine's Sumy kills at least two
cuerpo: At least two people were killed and seven were injured after a Russian aerial bomb struck an apartment building in the eastern Ukrainian city of Sumy late Friday, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and other officials said. A frequent target of Russian attacks, Sumy is located in an area where Moscow says it wants to establish a buffer zone. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.
